duration.text: The Pre-Bachelor Program at Chongqing Jiaotong University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1666 USD/per year ￥ 12000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Resume Written in Chinese and English You can download a template or sample from here 6. Health Certificate Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Certification of no criminal record

requirements.text: Non-Chinese, under 30 years old, good scores in high school
